description: Maximum favorite-adjacent circular seating in a bounded functional graph.

source.title: Maximum Employees to Be Invited to a Meeting; functional-graph decomposition
source.reuse: Algorithm ideas and public constraints only; no task text, examples, or code copied.

output.meaning: Maximum number of attendees in a circle where each attendee has their favorite adjacent.
output.two_attendee_rule: For a circle of size two, each attendee's previous and next seat are the other attendee.

algorithm_details.primary: Indegree-zero peeling propagates longest incoming chain lengths; then combine all extended mutual-pair components and compare their sum with the largest cycle of length at least three.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: Enumerate every nonempty attendee subset and circular ordering, fixing the least index to remove rotational duplicates; check favorite adjacency directly.
algorithm_details.primary_complexity: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle_complexity: O(n! * 2^n) worst-case bounded work and O(n) working space.
